name: mpa-vscode
description: Share one live agent session with your team — powered by Claude

commands.title: Multiplayer Agent: Stop Shared Agent (ends it for everyone)

mpa.relayUrl.description: WebSocket URL of the sync-server relay.

mpa.displayName.description: Name shown to other participants. You are asked for one the first time you join; it is saved per workspace so two windows can be two people.

mpa.agentHostEntry.description: Absolute path to agent-host dist/index.js. Leave empty to use the sibling package in this monorepo.

mpa.relayEntry.description: Absolute path to sync-server dist/index.js. The relay is started automatically when nothing is listening on mpa.relayUrl.

mpa.token.description: Token for a relay on another machine. Leave empty when the relay runs locally — its token is read automatically from ~/.multiplayer-agent/relay-token.

mpa.dbPath.description: Where an auto-started relay keeps its session log. Defaults to mpa-sessions.db beside the relay.

mpa.allowedTools.description: Comma-separated tools the shared agent may run without asking. Everything else goes to the room for approval.

mpa.disallowedTools.description: Tools nobody may approve, however much they want to. Empty by default: every tool outside mpa.allowedTools already needs a human decision, and the relay separately refuses writes to files someone is still editing.
